cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the IT Regular (SEO) position. With a strong foundation in SEO and hands-on experience in SEM, I am confident in my ability to drive organic growth and optimize paid campaigns for your partner company.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to content publishing. I have successfully improved organic visibility and search rankings by implementing targeted keyword strategies and technical optimizations. My work includes building and maintaining WordPress sites, ensuring they adhere to SEO best practices. I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Ads to track performance and guide decisions.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to apply advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and technical audits to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project also involved A/B testing and iterative improvements, demonstrating my analytical and test-driven approach.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines SEO and SEM, allowing me to leverage my skills in both areas. I have experience managing PPC campaigns and am familiar with bid management tools. I am eager to collaborate with development, editorial, and marketing teams to embed search best practices across digital experiences.

I am based in Belgium and comfortable working remotely. I am committed to continuous learning and staying current with search algorithm changes. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow my expertise in performance marketing.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
